newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech minister assaulted, unharmed-agency.
newsitem.headline: Czech minister assaulted, unharmed-agency.

text.p: A 27-year-old man assaulted Czech Agriculture Minister Josef Lux on Monday but the minister was unharmed and the attacker was quickly arrested, the local news agency CTK reported.

It quoted Prague police as saying the man was immediately detained after striking Lux in the main building of the Agriculture Ministry in mid-afternoon. CTK quoted sources as saying the man was armed with a knife, but this could not be independently confirmed.
No further details were immediately available.
Lux, 41, who leads the Christian Democratic Union (KDU-CSL), a centrist junior party in the centre-right Czech ruling coalition, is one of four deputy prime ministers.
